Jenna / Rajat —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. AuroraTek's pilot performance metrics look promising and we discussed pursuing ACE registration so the AWS PDM/PSM can support the co-sell motion. Can we do the following next steps this week?

1) Rajat — can you confirm the ACE intake owner and any missing fields on the registration form (attached)?
2) Jenna / Tom — please confirm the list of technical stakeholders who should be part of the POC readiness review.
3) Redwood internal: Kimberly / Aditya and I will draft a short mutual action plan and an initial entitlement ask (credits + 3-month dedicated capacity).

Thanks,
